arStrings.szText: {c_important}Blizzard's{/c} duration is increased to {c_number}[SF_12]{/c} seconds and it makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Blizzard{/c} forms {u}{c_important}Ice Spikes{/c}{/u} that explode twice if they hit a {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} enemy, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_ICE_SPIKE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Blizzard{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill, deals {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_TOOLTIP_DOT}{/c} Sparking damage over {c_number}[SF_34|1|]{/c} seconds, and costs {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} Mana.

{c_important}Blizzard{/c} periodically {c_important}Stuns{/c} enemies for {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADEC_STUN}|2|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Blizzard{/c} grants you a {u}{c_important}Barrier{/c}{/u} that absorbs {c_number}[SF_40 * 100 |1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} seconds every second for each affected enemy.
{c_important}Blizzard{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_43 * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.
{c_important}Blizzard{/c} now seeks enemies and its duration is increased by {c_number}[SF_44 * 100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Blizzard{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_45 * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and grants {c_number}{SF_46}{/c} Mana Regeneration for each active {c_important}Blizzard{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_47}*{SF_46}]{/c} Mana.
